stem:
As part of a survey, a group of people were asked to name their preferred method of viewing television shows. Their responses are shown in the table.

| Viewing Method   | Number of People | Key for Bar Graph |
|-----------------|------------------|-------------------|
| Live            | 8                | [white box]       |
| Recorded        | 9                | [light gray box]  |
| On demand       | 3                | [dark gray box]   |
| Online streaming| 5                | [black box]       |

Which percentage bar graph best represents the data?

options.label: A
options.text: [white box] 30%  [light gray box] 40%  [dark gray box] 10%  [black box] 20%

options.label: B
options.text: [white box] 30%  [light gray box] 40%  [dark gray box] 10%  [black box] 20%

options.label: C
options.text: [white box] 25%  [light gray box] 25%  [dark gray box] 40%  [black box] 10%

options.label: D
options.text: [white box] 35%  [light gray box] 10%  [dark gray box] 40%  [black box] 15%

visual_elements: Table: Viewing Method, Number of People, Key for Bar Graph with color boxes
Bar Graphs labeled A, B, C, D with different color segment percentages
notes: Stem preserves table content and question wording. Answer choices paraphrased to describe the bar segments as exact percentages are approximated visually from the graph.
